en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a Renaissance-style courtyard with a formal garden. The image shows a two-story palazzo enclosing a small, manicured garden featuring neatly trimmed bushes, small trees, and a circular fountain on the left. One wall is covered with ivy; another has an arcaded loggia with five rounded arches supported by columns. Above each arch is a circular medallion relief, likely depicting faces or coats of arms. The upper floor has rectangular windows and round oculi near the roofline. The building surfaces appear somewhat weathered, giving a historic character. No visible printed title or caption appears on the front.
